title: Competition Commission of India Paid Legal Internship
summary: One-month internship on competition law at CCI, starting on the first working day of the chosen month; about 15 seats per month.
eligibility: Indian law students: 3-year LLB in 2nd/3rd year, 5-year integrated LLB in 4th/final year, and LLM students, with an institutional recommendation. Students with a placement in hand are excluded.
notes: Rolling monthly batches; the last reported deadline was 30 September 2026. Pick your month on the form.
2–3 month internships may be considered with an institutional recommendation.
